# TextGradient

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Fonts` · record struct

```csharp
public readonly record struct TextGradient(Color Top, Color Bottom)
```

Types: [`Color`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Color.md)

Two colors a text's face is drawn in, one blending into the other down each line.

## Remarks

The blend runs down the height of the font's capitals (its ascent, where the font gives no cap height), the same for every character of a line, so a word is one sweep of color and not a sweep for each letter. Opacity fades both colors alike.
